nodes.title: SG-1.2.2 · Create the typed UI store in game/frontend/src/store
nodes.body:
Context: game/frontend has zustand ^5.1.0 declared (SG-1.2.1) but no src/store directory exists. Desired behavior: a Zustand UI store holds drawer open state, modal state, sound enabled and settings flags, with actions toggleDrawer, openModal, closeModal, toggleSound and toggleSettings, exported as a typed hook. Expected result: components can import useUiStore. Why: the shell, header and contribution modal share UI state.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the module src/store/uiStore.ts, when imported, then it exports a typed useUiStore hook and a UiState type
- Given the store, when each action is called, then drawer, modal, sound and settings state change as specified


## Scope
- In scope: game/frontend/src/store/uiStore.ts
- In scope: unit tests in game/frontend/tests
- Out of scope: Wiring the store into GameLayout, HeaderOverlay or App
- Out of scope: Persisting UI state
- Out of scope: Phaser integration
- Preserve: Existing components and tests
- Preserve: zustand dependency declaration


## Technical constraints
- Use zustand ^5.1.0 create() with TypeScript types
- Tests live in game/frontend/tests and match tests/**/*.test.{ts,tsx}


## Definition of done
- uiStore.ts exists and type-checks
- Unit tests pass


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · UI store exposes drawer and modal state with toggleDrawer, openModal and closeModal
nodes.body:
Context: no UI store exists. Desired behavior: useUiStore exposes drawerOpen (default false) and modal (default null, otherwise a ModalId such as 'contribution'), with toggleDrawer, openModal(id) and closeModal. Expected result: components can open the drawer and modals via the store. Why: mobile bottom drawer and the contribution modal need shared state.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given initial state, when read, then drawerOpen is false and modal is null
- Given drawerOpen false, when toggleDrawer is called twice, then drawerOpen becomes true then false
- Given modal null, when openModal('contribution') is called, then modal equals 'contribution'; when closeModal is called, then modal is null


## Scope
- In scope: drawerOpen, modal, toggleDrawer, openModal, closeModal
- Out of scope: Sound and settings flags
- Preserve: Existing components


## Technical constraints
- Single store file src/store/uiStore.ts


## Definition of done
- State and actions implemented and typed


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · UI store exposes sound and settings flags with toggleSound and toggleSettings
nodes.body:
Context: header needs sound toggle and settings. Desired behavior: useUiStore exposes soundEnabled (default true) and settingsOpen (default false) with toggleSound and toggleSettings. Expected result: each toggle flips only its own flag. Why: header sound and settings controls share state.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given initial state, when read, then soundEnabled is true and settingsOpen is false
- Given the store, when toggleSound is called, then soundEnabled flips and settingsOpen, drawerOpen and modal are unchanged
- Given the store, when toggleSettings is called, then settingsOpen flips and soundEnabled is unchanged


## Scope
- In scope: soundEnabled, settingsOpen, toggleSound, toggleSettings
- Out of scope: Audio playback
- Out of scope: Settings panel UI
- Preserve: Drawer and modal behavior


## Technical constraints
- Same store as drawer and modal


## Definition of done
- Flags and actions implemented and typed


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · A typed useUiStore hook is exported for components to import
nodes.body:
Context: components need a typed entry point. Desired behavior: uiStore.ts exports UiState, ModalId and useUiStore so selector calls like useUiStore(s => s.drawerOpen) are typed. Expected result: importing works under tsc --noEmit. Why: type-safe consumption by later shell work.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a component, when it calls useUiStore(s => s.soundEnabled), then it renders the current boolean value
- Given the store state changes, when an action runs, then subscribed components re-render with the new value


## Scope
- In scope: Exports of useUiStore, UiState, ModalId
- Out of scope: Refactoring existing components to use it
- Preserve: Existing exports


## Technical constraints
- Named exports only


## Definition of done
- Exports present and typed


## Clarifying questions
- None
